title: Advances in programmable DNA nanostructures enabling stimuli-responsive drug delivery and multimodal biosensing
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,1366-1385
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00057B, Review Article
Open Access

Yao Hong, Wenyue Ma, Meixia Wang, Hong-Hui Wang
Programmable DNA nanostructures enable stimuli-responsive drug delivery and multimodal biosensing. This review highlights their modular design, stability, and precision in disease-targeted therapy and early cancer diagnosis.
